news.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Profit skyrockets 407% YoY to Rs 375 crore, NII rises 81%
news.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a 407% year-on-year surge in Q2FY27 profit to Rs 375 crore, while net interest income rose 81%. Operating profit more than doubled, supported by business growth, improving asset quality and an expanded gold loan network.

news.title: Half of India’s MTF book is in smallcaps; Nithin Kamath flags liquidity risks
news.summary: Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath warned that small and microcap stocks account for a substantial share of India’s margin trading facility book. He highlighted liquidity risks during market downturns, when smaller stocks may face sharper selling pressure.

news.title: Adani Power shares: GQG Partners-managed entities cut stake to 5.72% from 5.74%
news.summary: GQG Partners entities sold 50.39 lakh Adani Power shares through on-market transactions, reducing their combined stake to 5.72% from 5.74%. The disclosure comes as the stock gains 27.05% in 2026 and the company expands into Bhutanese hydropower.
